frequency_question: How often do high-complexity defense industrial localization efforts succeed in operationalizing within a compressed multi-year timeline?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign defense localization efforts for cruise missiles, air defense systems, or advanced precision munitions initiated under emergency wartime or high-threat duress over the past 40 years. Excludes standard peacetime commercial joint ventures or simple ammunition manufacturing.

cases.name: Taiwan Hsiung Feng III domestic production scaling
Ukraine Neptune cruise missile domestic production stand-up
Pakistan Babur cruise missile localization program
Iran Soumar/Qods cruise missile reverse-engineering and production
India-Russia BrahMos joint production localization (initial targets)

coverage_note: 5 named cases representing modern sovereign missile industrial localization under duress.
known_gaps: Classified Western tech transfers of sub-component assembly lines to non-NATO partners are sparse in public datasets.
skeleton: 5 historical analogous advanced missile localization programs under pressure; successful operational domestic manufacturing achieved in 4 out of 5 cases.
validity_reason: Industrial base digitization and modular manufacturing trends remain relatively stable through the decade.
